LESSON: BIBLE PATRIARCHS ABRAHAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.6: Bible Patriarchs Abraham

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Bible Patriarchs Abraham
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why was the name Abram changed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
2. discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
3. appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life

• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
• Model 2: discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
• Model 3: appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
2. Practise: discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
3. Practise: appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was the name Abram changed?
2. How did Abraham show obedience to God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• obey God’s instructions in his or her day-to-day life
• discuss Abram’s change of name to Abraham
• appreciate God’s blessings in his or her life
